references.text: Here are given the detailed instructions for building the bronze altar mentioned in 31:9, including dimensions and materials.
Describes the actual construction of the bronze altar and its utensils made by Bezalel.
Here are given the instructions for the bronze basin (kiyyoren) and its stand mentioned in 31:9.
Describes the actual construction of the bronze basin and its stand.
Moses is instructed to place the bronze altar and the bronze basin in their proper locations within the tabernacle.
Moses sets up the bronze altar and the bronze basin as described in the instructions.
The altar and its utensils are anointed by Moses during the consecration of the tabernacle.
Solomon dedicated the central part of the courtyard for burnt offerings, showing the continuation of the altar's function in the temple.
The details of the instruction (30:28) are confirmed as part of the complete list of holy utensils in 31:9.
The completion of the work (39:39) confirms that the specific utensils mentioned in the instruction (31:9) were carried out exactly according to plan.
The people's assignment (35:16) repeats the specific holy items from God's instruction (31:9), emphasizing unity in planning.
Details what 'all its utensils' (mentioned in 31:9) actually consist of, highlighting the completeness of the sacrificial worship.
